canonical_title: Stall recovery with the critical engine inoperative

versions.title_at_revision: Stall recovery with the critical engine inoperative
versions.text:
Standard: The multi-engine air vehicle can be recovered from stalls with the critical engine inoperative. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's recovery characteristics from stalls with the critical engine inoperative and thrust on the remaining engines at the settings as specified in MIL-STD-1797, One-Engine-Out Stalls for Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's recovery characteristics from stalls with the critical engine inoperative and thrust on the remaining engines at the settings as specified in MIL-STD-1797, One-Engine-Out Stalls for Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's recovery characteristics from stalls with the critical engine inoperative and thrust on the remaining engines at the settings as specified in MIL-STD-1797, One-Engine-Out Stalls for Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental condition.
